title: Choose who is told at each stage of every process
description: Notifications in Admin settings now show each process as a flow — its steps, how it can end, and where work goes back — and each stage lists who is told, in the app and by email.
items: Client requests, leave, overtime and corrections, timesheets and tasks each have their own flow
Click a stage to switch the app or email on or off for each person told
Add a role or a named person to any stage; it never changes who approves
The CEO and business manager are told in the app whenever a process ends; their email starts off
The client request flow now includes PIC and QA assignment, the hand-off to QA, QA sending work back and the send to the client
Replaces the old per-type email switches
